import {cpSync, mkdirSync, mkdtempSync, symlinkSync, writeFileSync} from 'node:fs'
import {appendFile, copyFile, cp, writeFile} from 'node:fs/promises'
import {tmpdir} from 'node:os'
import {join} from 'node:path'

const ROOT = join(tmpdir(), 'fixed-root')
const MADE = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'made-'))

export async function makePaths(source: string): Promise<void> {
  mkdirSync(join(tmpdir(), 'x'), {recursive: true})
  await writeFile(join(tmpdir(), 'f'), '')
  await cp(source, join(tmpdir(), 'd'), {recursive: true})
  cpSync(source, `${tmpdir()}/copy`)
  writeFileSync(ROOT, '')
  mkdirSync(join(ROOT, 'nested'))
  await appendFile(join(process.env.TMPDIR ?? '', 'log'), '')
  await copyFile(source, '/tmp/conciv-copy')
  symlinkSync(source, join(tmpdir(), 'link'))
  writeFileSync(join(MADE, 'inside'), '')
}
